description_en: Upgrades an approved text SMS signature to a 5G messaging signature
description_zh: 将已通过审核的文本短信签名升级为5G消息签名
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi upgrade-to-rcs-signature --sign-name '阿里云' --logo China_regions0000/aliyun_logo_1750000.png --service-phone 400-800-0000 --service-email service@example.com --service-website https://www.example.com --service-terms https://www.example.com/terms --office-address No.XX,_XX_Road,_Xihu_District,_Hangzhou --bubble-color '#FF0000' --background-image China_regions0000/background_1750000.png --category 1 --description Aliyun_official_Chatbot --longitude 120.000 --latitude 30.000 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeToRCSSignature

parameters.help_en: The signature name. The signature must be an existing and available text SMS signature
parameters.help_zh: 签名名称。需为已存在的可用文本短信签名
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en: The fileKey of the logo image. Obtain this value by uploading an image through the [GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~) operation. The logo image must not exceed 50 KB in size and must be 400 × 400 pixels
parameters.help_zh: Logo图片的 fileKey。通过[GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~)接口上传图片后获取。 Logo图片大小不超过50KB，尺寸为400乘以400像素
parameters.name: logo

parameters.help_en: The service phone number. Chinese characters are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 服务电话。不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: service_phone

parameters.help_en: The service email address. Chinese characters are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 服务邮箱。不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: service_email

parameters.help_en: The service website URL. Must start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 服务官网URL。必须以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: service_website

parameters.help_en: The terms of service URL. Must start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 服务条款URL。必须以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: service_terms

parameters.example: No.XX, XX Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou
parameters.help_en: The office address. Square brackets in Chinese or English are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 办公地址。不能包含中英文中括号
parameters.name: office_address

parameters.help_en: The fileKey of the background image. Obtain this value by uploading an image through the [GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 背景图片的 fileKey。通过[GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~)接口上传图片后获取
parameters.name: background_image

parameters.help_en: The description. English double quotation marks, backslashes, or emojis are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 描述信息。不可包含英文双引号、反斜杠或 emoji
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The longitude of the address location. Numeric format with up to 3 decimal places
parameters.help_zh: 地址位置经度。数字格式，小数点后最多3位
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.help_en: The latitude of the address location. Numeric format with up to 3 decimal places
parameters.help_zh: 地址位置纬度。数字格式，小数点后最多3位
parameters.name: latitude

AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝时返回的详细信息

Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

Success.description_zh:
